fonts.text:
Each horizontal row is a five-symbol hand. THREE OF A
KIND or higher pays. A single pair and two pairs do not
pay. Eligible: three of a kind, full house, four or five of a
kind.

Bet is divided equally across 3 hands. Pay the highest
eligible category per hand × hand bet × cabinet factor.
WILD substitutes. No suits, flushes or straights;
SCATTER/BONUS never form a pair.

Highlighted cells illustrate positions, not a guaranteed win.
Apply the symbol, direction and region conditions above.
Payouts depend on the paytable and total stake; feature
awards are separate.

labels:
Match 3+ consecutive reels starting at the RIGHT edge.
Any matching row may connect on each reel. A matching
run away from the right edge does not pay; no reel may
be skipped.

Pay each combination of the longest eligible run once:
bet ÷ 2187 × combinations × count paytable factor ×
cabinet factor. WILD substitutes; pure-WILD combinations
pay only as WILD. Shorter subruns do not pay again.

Highlighted cells illustrate positions, not a guaranteed win.
Apply the symbol, direction and region conditions above.
Payouts depend on the paytable and total stake; feature
awards are separate.
Base-game diagram · Feature steps are on FEATURES
